Game Overview

At its heart, Waano Bot is a arcade game about embark on a thrilling 2D sci-fi journey as a robot collecting secret chips across dangerous terrains. Master double jumps to navigate soaring droids and giant blades. With eight increasingly challenging levels, evade enemies and find the exit, testing your reflexes and strategic prowess every step of the way.
